findings.message: Absence-as-positive framing: "on 1 page" without naming the page — when a gap affects exactly 1 page, name the page path inline (e.g. "missing on `/services/example-page`"). Only use "see structured-data-findings.csv" when 2+ pages are affected.
findings.context: **Finding:** Heading levels skip on 1 audited page(s) (for example an h2 followed by an h4), so the document outline a machine or screen reader builds does not match the visible structure.

findings.description: Priority 1 recommendation: generic "Give every custom control an accessible name…" lacks a selector or data anchor.
Priority 2 recommendation: generic "Add descriptive alt text to every informative image…" is not anchored to specific images.
Priority 3 recommendation: generic "Expose the structure a sighted user sees…" lacks element-specific data.
Priority 4 recommendation: generic "Add a skip link as the first focusable element…" is not tied to any page or selector.
Priority 5 recommendation: generic "Order headings without skipping levels…" has no specific heading context.
Priority 6 recommendation: generic "Replace the obvious landmark containers…" lacks a target selector or page reference.
Priority 7 recommendation: generic performance profiling advice is not linked to any particular route or metric.
Priority 8 recommendation: generic header addition advice applies site‑wide without referencing missing headers per URL.
Priority 9 recommendation: generic SEO metadata completion lacks page‑specific guidance.
Priority 10 recommendation: generic Schema.org property completion is not tied to specific entities or URLs.
Priority 11 recommendation: generic Schema.org coverage improvement lacks entity‑level data anchors.
